title: Release the card-file follower clutch, slot the tabbed divider upright, and slide the follower snug until it locks
instruction: Release the follower clutch, slot the tabbed divider upright between the two card packs, slide the follower snug until it locks, and clear both grippers.
context: Every home recipe box, study flashcard file, and desktop 4x6 index-card organizer uses a spring-clutch follower block on a centre rod to hold upright card packs and A-Z dividers vertical without slumping when cards or dividers are inserted. Because the follower block starts locked 34 mm forward with the rear card pack backed directly against the clutch-locked steel follower plate (1 mm slack before rigid steel-on-steel stop, leaving an 8 mm gap that rigidly blocks a 20 mm-shoed divider until the clutch releases), and pushing the follower forward against the 110 N/m card-pack spring and 0.11 N m/rad cam-clutch catch slides an unbraced 260 g steel tray across a smooth desk blotter, stabilizing the tray while releasing the clutch, slotting the divider, and sliding the follower snug keeps the file organized.
setup: A fixed dark-slate smooth desk blotter (300 x 430 x 14 mm, on 3 mm rubber corner feet, friction 0.03) sits on the station tabletop with lateral oak tray alignment strips around (0.235, -0.060) m and a front oak staging cradle at (0.235, -0.172) m. An unbolted 260 g open-top steel 4x6 desktop card-file tray (120 x 156 mm floor, low 18 mm side rails, front brass label holder, steel centre guide rod, fixed front upright ivory card pack, and an offset +X/+Y 30 x 42 x 24 mm knurled rear stabilizer handle at (0.295, 0.145) m caged by 46 mm brass shoulders) rests at (0.235, -0.060) m. Inside the tray sit a 34 g spring-loaded movable rear card pack (110 N/m expansion spring) and a 52 g steel follower block (65 N/m return spring, rear knurled push paddle, and two-position ratchet lugs with a 20 deg cam ramp and flat keeper heel) initially locked 34 mm forward by a 30 g spring-loaded horizontal seesaw cam-clutch lever (pivoted at (0.199, -0.072) m, 0.11 N m/rad return spring, red front release paddle on -X), holding the two card packs 8 mm apart. A 42 g rigid amber-tabbed pressboard index divider (64 x 10 x 28 mm card on a 20 mm weighted brass base shoe with a 24 x 20 x 24 mm top grip block) stands upright in the front cradle at (0.235, -0.172) m. One fixed starting layout; arms start at ready pose.
scoring: Judged from pure physical end-state geometry with a caliper, ruler, and digital protractor; the run succeeds once 1.0 holds continuously for 3.0 s (60 steps at 20 Hz). Possible scores 0.0, 0.25, 0.50, 0.75, 1.0. 1.0: the card-file tray stays within 16 mm horizontally and 6 mm vertically of its desk blotter datum zone tilted at most 5 deg, the tabbed index divider stands upright within 10 deg on the tray floor within 22 mm laterally and 15 mm longitudinally of the slot between the two card packs, the follower block sits in its 12 to 26 mm divider-installed snug window from open rest with the cam-clutch lever locked within 8 deg, and both grippers are more than 120 mm clear of the tray, rear handle, divider, follower block, and clutch paddle. 0.75: tray registered, divider upright between the card packs, and follower snug (12 to 26 mm) and locked, gripper within 120 mm. 0.50: tray registered, divider upright between the card packs, and follower inside the 12 to 26 mm snug window, cam-clutch lever not locked within 8 deg. 0.25: tray registered and divider upright between the card packs, follower block outside the 12 to 26 mm snug window. 0.0: otherwise (doing nothing, divider blocked atop closed packs without releasing clutch, or unbraced tray shifted past 16 mm).
reset_notes: Press the red -X cam-clutch paddle inward, lift the 42 g tabbed divider back to the front oak cradle at (0.235, -0.172) m, push the 52 g follower block 34 mm forward until the first ratchet lug latches with the two card packs 8 mm apart, and seat the 260 g steel tray on the desk blotter at (0.235, -0.060) m.
fidelity: Rigid-body simulation (20 Hz control). Card-stack expansion and follower rod stiction are modelled using a 34 g, 110 N/m movable rear card pack and a 52 g, 65 N/m steel follower block engaging a separate 30 g, 0.11 N m/rad horizontal seesaw cam-clutch lever (20 deg non-locking cam ramp, flat keeper heel, and two ratchet positions: 34 mm empty-pack lock and 12 to 26 mm divider-installed lock); the index divider is a 42 g rigid tabbed block with a 20 mm weighted base shoe.
